We’re Comfort Hotel® – a hotel chain that promises to give our guests what they need, and skip the unnecessary. We have great locations, urban design and we’re offering selected services, but the service we give is great. We aim to be Easy on the wallet, have Easy access, be Easy to enjoy and last but definitely not least – be Easy on the planet. Comfort Hotel® is part of Strawberry.
Ready to be part of our crew? 
At Comfort Hotel Göteborg we keep things real, urban, and uncomplicated. We give our guests what they need and skip the fluff, creating a space where locals, travelers, startups, and globetrotters all feel at home. We’re looking for a housekeeping team member who gets our vibe - someone who knows how to make guests feel welcomed, the importance of a spotless room and someone who knows that the devil is in the details. Comfort Hotel  has taken the undisputed position as the Nordic region's leading budget hotel chain.
What you’ll be doing:
Meeting guests with a friendly, no-nonsense approach, setting the tone for a great stay.
Cleaning rooms and “Keeping house” according to the Comfort Housekeeping Manual.
Keep the hotel clean and tidy, buzzing with energy and positivity, working closely with colleagues to maintain Comfort’s effortless, urban vibe.
Make sure daily operations are run in compliance with our resource-efficiency targets and Nordic Swan Ecolabel standards.
Work hours will be according to schedule with different shifts from 07.00-22.00 and will include weekends and holidays.

Is this you?
You’re upbeat, approachable, and thrive in a fast-paced, urban environment
You’re excited to be part of a diverse team, with colleagues from several backgrounds
Quick on your feet, you adapt to whatever the day throws your way - with a smile
Experience in hospitality or customer service is a bonus, but your personality and drive are what really count

As a housekeeping crew member at Comfort Hotel, you need to have a basic knowledge of either English or Swedish. Proficiency in either is a plus and additional language skills may be beneficial to your application. 
That little extra we offer our employees at Strawberry
We believe in making things easy - not just for our guests, but for our team too. Here’s what you’ll get:
A fast-paced, energetic work environment that values your individuality
Opportunities to grow and make your mark within the Strawberry group
Staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 200+ hotels
Four free hotel nights each year
A 25% discount on food & beverages at our restaurants and bars
Sweet deals on experiences, travel, retail, and more.
Access to a digital training and development tool with some mandatory and LOTS of other courses

About Strawberry
Strawberry is not your typical hotel company. With over 240 hotels, 120 restaurants, and 20 spas, we create thousands of experiences every day. Built on our core values - energy, courage, and enthusiasm - our team of 20,000 employees from 166 countries keeps us moving forward.
Perfect match much?
Apply now and be part of a team that makes every stay easy, urban, and unforgettable. We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t wait - positions may be filled before the deadline. This is a temporary position for 75% with a start date to be agreed upon.

Do you want to be part of a team that is developing tomorrow's businesses and organizations? At PwC, we strive to be proactive advisors that really make a difference in society. We see that experience and knowledge are invaluable assets, so it's crucial to us that you contribute with your expertise to promote PwC's development. Together, we create a meaningful and rewarding career for you.Become part of PwC's audit operations at the Gothenburg officeAs an employee in audit, you work to identify risks, solve complex audit questions, analyze data and draw conclusions about the information presented by our customers. You get to work in inspiring and meaningful assignments where our work affects our customers' business operations, but also contributes to creating trust in society. Read more about our service areas within auditingWho are you?We are looking for you who have:

At least five years of working with auditing and/or qualified financial statement work.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

We attach great importance to your personal qualities and therefore believe that you:

Is service oriented and motivated by delivering results and meeting our customers' expectations.
Is adaptable, can read situations and adapt both behavior and communication in building qualitative and diversified relationships.
Acts with integrity by being straightforward and honest in communication and is easy to get others on board with
Has good analytical skills and is solution-oriented. You enjoy learning new things and are curious about digitization and new technology to be able to solve customers' needs.
Has interpersonal skills and the ability to create relationships and networks. These skills are needed to work well with our clients, but are of course also important for collaboration within our team.
Is structured, efficient and organized.

The recruitment ProcessWe will review applications continuously, and the position may be filled earlier than the application deadline.Please attach the following documents to your application:

CV

We believe in the strength of having a recruitment process that applies to everyone. As part of the selection, we use psychometric tests to ensure an objective, unbiased, and fair selection. The tests are the first step in our selection process. You will receive a link to these tests after we have received your application.We value the personal meeting to understand the value you can bring to PwC and what we can offer you. The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews. When meeting with HR, you will have a competency-based interview where we examine the personality test you completed before the interview. During the interview with the business, you will have the opportunity to meet with the relevant team to discuss the role. We call for interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

På PwC hjälper vi våra kunder att bygga förtroende och ställa om sin verksamhet för att öka konkurrenskraften. Vi är ledande inom skatt, revision och rådgivning och är en del av ett globalt nätverk med 364 000 medarbetare i 136 länder. Genom att kombinera vår expertis och erfarenhet med den senaste tekniken, hjälper vi våra kunder att bli effektivare, anpassa sig till förändringar och alltid ligga steget före.

PwC Sverige är en självständig och oberoende juridisk enhet med drygt 3 000 medarbetare runt om i landet.

Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
Support and execute improvement projects related to material flow, internal transportation, storage and production line supply
Develop and update drawings for flow racks, trolleys and material handling equipment using CAD
You will have the opportunity to plan and execute logistics-related improvement projects
Collect, analyze, and visualize logistics data using analytical tools to identify improvement opportunities and support KPI follow-ups
You will be Applying industrial engineering methods, including ergonomics assessments, standardized work, process mapping and FMEA
Prepare and participate in workshops, collaborate with cross-functional teams and follow up on project activities
Support project planning, documentation, and routine administrative tasks to ensure projects stay organized and on track.

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Structured and goal oriented. With ability to work independently and approach people easily
Strong interest in manufacturing, logistics and continuous improvement
Basic knowledge of CAD software (AutoCAD or similar) is an advantage.
Knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Good analytical skills and problem-solving mindset
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

Service Desk Specialist - Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)
Kalix, Sweden
Full-time
Remote Type: On-Site
Job Area: Technical and Functional Expertise
Business Unit: Banktech

Job Description
Are you passionate about customer service, technology, and problem-solving? We are looking for a Service Desk Specialist to join Tieto Banktech's Service and Support team in Kalix, Sweden. In this role, you will help support business-critical banking and financial services used across the Nordic and European markets while delivering an outstanding customer experience. 
Tieto Banktech is a leading financial services software and solutions partner in the Nordics, delivering modular, pre-integrated Banking-as-a-Service platforms and mission-critical software for core banking, payments, credit, cards, fraud prevention, and wealth management. Our solutions operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments where security, resilience, and compliance are non-negotiable. 
As a Service Desk Specialist, you will be part of our 1st line support team and serve as an important link between our customers and internal teams. You will handle and coordinate incidents and service requests, communicate with customers, collaborate with colleagues across the organization, and contribute to high-quality service delivery. 
This is a full-time, office-based position in Kalix, with close collaboration with colleagues in several international locations. 
 
When joining Tieto Banktech as a Service Desk Specialist, you will:
Monitor and manage incidents, problems, changes, service requests, and orders in our ITSM platform. 
Follow our ITIL-based processes to ensure smooth operations. 
Investigate, coordinate, and follow up on incoming tickets. 
Work closely with customers, 2nd line support, IT Operations, and Delivery Managers. 
Escalate unresolved or critical issues to the appropriate teams. 
Participate in and facilitate customer follow-ups and operational review meetings. 
Prepare service reports, operational follow-ups, presentations, and monthly customer reviews. 
Ensure agreed service levels and delivery commitments are met. 
Contribute to continuous improvements in our services, processes, and ways of working. 

 
Who we are looking for 
Experience in customer service, technical support, Service Desk, or a similar customer-facing role. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Experience with ITSM tools, ITIL processes, financial services, SaaS platforms, or other business-critical IT services is considered an advantage
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish or another Scandinavian language is an advantage. 
An interest in technology and a willingness to continuously learn. 
The ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 
 
We offer 
We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge. 
We value close collaboration and a strong sense of community, and therefore this is a full-time, office-based position in Kalix. 
You will join an international environment where knowledge sharing, curiosity, continuous learning, and teamwork are part of how we work. 
 
Did we get you inspired? 
We look forward to your application! 
Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today! For more information or questions, please contact Talent Acquisition team recruitmentinbanking@tieto.com 
Hope to hear from you soon! 
 
We perform background checks on all final candidates. 
Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

About the job
Microdentify Sweden AB (https://microdentify.com/) develops cutting-edge biotechnology and AI-driven solutions for law enforcement, national security, and defense. Operating at the intersection of computational biology, artificial intelligence, and forensic intelligence, we are pioneering next-generation technologies designed to address some of the most complex challenges in security and defense.
Microdentify is seeking an excellent Bioinformatician or Computational Biologist to conduct computational analyses of environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing data, using machine-learning approaches for biological and forensic applications.
The position involves analyzing sequencing datasets to identify biological patterns, develop computational methods for classification and prediction, build pipelines, and develop software to deliver results. The role focuses on analyzing biological and environmental DNA profiles and developing models for forensic intelligence.

Main responsibilities
The successful candidate will:
· Process and analyze environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing datasets.
· Analyze biological community profiles generated from environmental samples.
· Apply statistical and machine-learning approaches to classification and prediction problems.
· Develop and evaluate computational models for geographic prediction from biological data. Create Nextflow pipelines.
· Analyze spatial patterns in biological communities and assess relationships between biological similarity and geographic distance.
· Evaluate model performance using appropriate validation and testing procedures.
· Work with large reference datasets containing biological and geographic information.
· Produce figures, tables, and statistical summaries of analytical results.
· Document computational workflows and contributions to scientific reports, presentations, and manuscripts.
· Work collaboratively with researchers in bioinformatics, molecular biology, environmental genomics, and forensic science.
· Develop an interface for law enforcement and defense.

Qualifications
Applicants should have:
· An MSc or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.
· Experience analyzing DNA or eDNA sequencing or other high-dimensional biological data.
· Experience with Python for data analysis.
· Experience with machine learning and statistical modeling.
· Experience working with biological community, microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data.
· Ability to work with large datasets and develop reproducible computational analyses.
· Good written and spoken English.
· Excellent grades and/or publications
· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.
Meritorious qualifications
· High-quality publications in eDNA, metagenomics, machine learning, or forensics
· Experience with feature selection and dimensionality reduction for high-dimensional sequencing data.
· Experience training LLMs.
About the position
This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of bioinformatics, environmental genomics, machine learning, and forensic science, with an emphasis on developing computational approaches to analyze biological sequencing data and build practical predictive tools.
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, independence, and an interest in developing computational approaches to challenging biological problems.
About Microdentify
Microdentify Sweden AB is a pioneering deep-tech startup operating at the frontier of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and forensic intelligence. We are developing next-generation technologies for high-stakes applications in law enforcement, national security, and defense, pushing the boundaries of what we can extract from biological data.
We are assembling a select team of exceptional AI researchers and developers to tackle complex, unconventional challenges at the cutting edge of science and technology. This is a rare opportunity to work on groundbreaking, mission-critical technologies, where innovation meets real-world intelligence and discretion is paramount.
Applicants should submit.
Cover letter
CV
Transcripts
Diploma
Proof of work with microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data

Email all your materials to
Nicla's attention at: jobs@microdentify.com

Data Engineering Manager 
Remote within Sweden 
Some travel, under about five days a quarter 
Every request, quote, and booking on Avinode is a signal nobody else holds. Today it sits in pipelines that work but were built one at a time, for the needs of the moment. We're building the foundation that turns it into governed, reusable data: one identity for member, company, aircraft, and trip; contracts on every source; and quality you can see rather than assume. 
We're looking for a data engineering manager and tech lead: the person who builds that foundation with their hands and builds the team around it. About seven days in ten, you'll be writing code, reviewing designs, and settling architecture. The rest is people: you'll lead a small team and shape who joins it. 
What you'll do 

You’ll hold the technical direction for our data platform on Databricks, and write a good part of it yourself. 

You’ll own acquisition, modeling, and data quality: contracts for every source we depend on, tests, monitoring, lineage, access control. You’ll set the review bar, and move pipeline and test code to proposed changes that get reviewed. 

You’ll keep your own work off the critical path, so the team never waits for you and the people side never gets dropped. 

You’ll lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers. Hire for open roles, set clear expectations, and support each person’s performance, development, and growth. 

You’ll work with the Director of Data & AI on sequencing and standards, with our product manager for data on what we promise, and with Engineering on platform, security and oncall. 
Who you are 

You have real hands-on depth in data engineering on a modern platform: ingestion, modeling, quality, and the pipelines that stay up. 

You have real hands-on experience with Databricks in production: jobs, Delta, Unity Catalog, cost control. 

You have a strong interest in not only the technology, but the business outcomes it enables. 

You have worked with data scientists and ML engineers and know what turns a notebook into something that serves. 

You communicate clearly in writing: you document decisions, data contracts, and standards so the team can move forward without needing you in every conversation. 

You have experience managing or leading a small team, or formally mentoring engineers, and an interest in continuing to build hands-on while leading others. 
Nice-to-haves 

Having been the first lead of a data team, or built one. ML platform experience, feature pipelines, or model serving. 
What you’ll work with 

Databricks, Python, SQL.
What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.
We want to support your development and dreams.
Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.occupation: Manager Breakfast, Minibar and Room Service
jobs.description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability. 
 
We are now looking for a passionate F&B leader to oversee our Breakfast, Room Service, and Minibar operations. This is a fixed-term full-time position covering parental leave, for a minimum duration of 6 months.
 
For this role, we are looking for someone who is responsible, flexible and enjoys problem solving. You are a team player who has a passion for service to exceed our guests' expectations.
 
As Breakfast, Room Service & Minibar Manager, you will run one of the most important parts of the guest experience and you will be the key person in ensuring that we deliver outstanding customer service. The role involves identifying areas for improvement, implementing strategic solutions and collaborating with various departments to ensure guests receive a first-class experience at all times.
 
Main responsibilities:
Take a leading role in planning, organizing and managing your operations on a daily basis.
Supervise and assist in the service of quality food & beverage products to customers in the breakfast/lunch operation. 
Ensure that the quality of the breakfast buffet is always kept to the highest standard. 
Ensure guest requests are fulfilled and problems solved in a timely manner.
Ensure that the mini bar operation runs smoothly in terms of visual aspect, refilling and stock control.
Ensure all VIP amenities are delivered on time and according to standard. 
Perform admin duties such as scheduling, ordering and inventory control as requested by senior management.
Do employee performances reviews whenever required.
Develop a structured training plan for all team members and assure product quality and service standards are being followed at all times.
Assist other F&B outlets when required by covering shifts and supporting fellow managers. 
Optimize profitability and work toward the restaurant´s set financial results by delivering long- and short-term efficiency goals.
Lead the team towards the set guest satisfaction goals by coaching, inspiring and motivating the staff toward guest-focused results.

Qualifications:
You have at least 3 years experience working in a similar position at a high-end restaurant and/or hotel where you had responsibility to lead a team.
Ambitious and interested in working in a high-pace environment with great standards.
Out-going personality who has the ability to communicate with ease and ensure our guests feel welcome.
Structure and good organizational skills.
Extensive knowledge of food and drinks.
Experience with demand-driven scheduling.
Knowledge within profitability optimization and cost control.
Ability to work independently, pro-actively and with high professional ethics.

Ability to motivate and inspire teams.
Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on guests' needs and expectations.

Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene.
Great opportunities for career growth.
A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
Employee discounted rates at over 8,000 hotels worldwide. 
Does this position sound interesting and like a good fit for you?
Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world-class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we're shaping the future, and we want you to be part of it.
We are now looking for a Junior Controller to join Gardena Division, part of Husqvarna Group, and strengthen our Finance team's operational and analytical capabilities as we continue to grow.
About the role
In this role, you will be part of a stable and experienced Finance team that plays a key role in the operational success of our business. This role mixes hands-on controlling with financial analysis, process improvement, and management reporting.
You will work closely with the Nordics Hub Business Controller, Sales, and other stakeholders across the organization. As you settle into the role, you will gradually take full responsibility for operational controlling across the Nordic markets.
Your main responsibilities include:
Controlling, month-end close, forecast and budget for the Nordics (Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland).
Support accounts receivable (AR) control in close collaboration with Sales and internal stakeholders to keep AR healthy and help evaluate credit limits.
Support the monthly cost allocation, calculate, and follow up on customer bonuses.
Support sales teams with financial input and questionnaires.
Identify inefficiencies and drive improvements across finance workflows, using modern tools, Excel add-ins, and AI applications.
Help with various accounting and controlling tasks across the P&L and Balance Sheet.

You will report to our Regional Controlling Manager.
About you
You're a structured and thorough finance professional with a good eye for detail. Planning your work comes naturally and staying flexible when priorities change does too.
With clear communication, you feel comfortable sharing your thoughts, whether that's asking questions, bringing ideas or raising something that's caught your attention. Finding smarter ways of working motivates you, and working independently suits you just as well as being part of a team.
In addition, you bring:
A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or business administration.
Around 1–3 years of experience in a controlling, accounting or finance role, with a strong grasp of end-to-end accounting principles, P&L and Balance Sheet.
Strong Excel skills and openness to using modern automation and AI tools.
Experience with a passion for financial analysis, generating data-driven insights, monitoring data quality, and summarizing and presenting financial data.
Strong communication and organizational skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Location
This role is based in Huskvarna, Sweden.
We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
Your Application
Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we find the right person. For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Johan Odelfelt at johan.odelfelt@husqvarnagroup.com
Processing of personal data
When you submit your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

Do you have experience in subscription management, billing or accounts receivable and want to take the next step in a growing SaaS company? Are you interested in financial processes, systems and finding smarter ways of working? Then the role as Finance Operations Specialist at iBinder could be the right opportunity for you!
About iBinder
iBinder is a Swedish SaaS company that develops digital information management services for the construction and real estate industry. With more than 700,000 users, iBinder helps customers create structure, improve collaboration and manage information more efficiently. Founded in 2005 and owned by Fidelio Capital since 2019, the company is in an exciting growth phase, with a strong focus on developing its business and offering.
About the role as Finance Operations Specialist
As Finance Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in managing and developing iBinder's financial operations, with a particular focus on subscription management, invoicing and accounts receivable. You will be responsible for ensuring a smooth and accurate process from quote to payment, working closely with both internal stakeholders and customers.
You will join the Finance Operations team and report to the Head of Global Finance Operations. The role combines hands-on operational responsibilities with opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data quality and contribute to automation initiatives. You will also collaborate closely with the sales team to ensure that customer agreements, renewals and new business are handled correctly throughout the financial flow.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Manage subscriptions, invoicing and accounts receivable, including payment follow-ups, collections and customer inquiries related to agreements and payments.
Work closely with Sales to ensure accurate customer agreements and billing, while supporting renewals, upselling and new business.
Perform accounts receivable reconciliations, support month-end closing activities and monitor key Quote-to-Cash KPIs.
Identify discrepancies, improve data quality and contribute to process improvements, automation and AI initiatives.
Support documentation and internal controls to ensure efficient and reliable financial processes.

About you
We are looking for someone who is structured, detail-oriented and enjoys taking ownership of their work. You are comfortable working independently, while also appreciating close collaboration with colleagues across different functions. You have a proactive mindset, enjoy solving problems and are always looking for ways to improve existing processes.
You thrive in a role that combines operational responsibilities with development opportunities. With a genuine interest in systems, data and automation, you are curious about how technology can make financial processes smarter and more efficient.
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:
At least 3 years of experience in a similar role within subscription management, billing, accounts receivable or Quote-to-Cash.
Experience from a SaaS or subscription-based business, with a good understanding of recurring revenue models and the financial flow from quote to payment.
Strong Excel skills and a genuine interest in systems and automation.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.
It is considered a plus if you have experience working with Salesforce, Younium and/or NetSuite.

iBinder offers
At iBinder, you will have the opportunity to join a growing SaaS company where finance operations are an important part of the business. You will work in a collaborative environment, gain broad exposure across the organization and have the opportunity to influence and improve processes as the company continues to grow. The position is based at iBinder's Stockholm office, with the flexibility to work remotely two days per week.
Other information
Start: By agreement
Extent: Full-time, 100%
Location: Stockholm
Does the role as Finance Operations Specialist at iBinder sound interesting? Submit your application today! We at Needo look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Internship – Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Energy Transfer &
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company with 12 million customers and approximately 21,000 employees. We are convinced that there is a way to build a future in which everyone can choose fossil-free ways to transport, produce, and live.

Job Description

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you'll have the opportunity to complete your internship close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.
About the internship
As an intern, you will join the Energy Transfer & Environment group within Vattenfall R&D Laboratories, working alongside specialists in fluid mechanics and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Our work includes numerical flow modelling and experimental measurements for energy applications, including hydropower and nuclear power.
During the internship, you will work with CFD on a defined fluid-mechanics problem relevant to the group’s ongoing activities. Proposed tasks include preparing simulation models and computational meshes, setting up and running simulations, evaluating flow behaviour, and comparing results with available experimental data or reference cases, where applicable. The specific application and simulation tools will be agreed with the supervisor.
The aim of the internship is to develop practical skills in CFD and contribute to the understanding of an energy-related flow problem. You will document modelling assumptions, assess the quality and limitations of the results, and present your findings in a technical report and a final presentation to the group.
Duration: Five months, full-time.This internship is for two students. 

Qualifications

We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in ongoing studies and are eager to put their knowledge into practice through an internship at Vattenfall. You are also someone who identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive, and Safety. In addition, we expect you to meet the following requirements:
Education: Ongoing university studies in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Energy Engineering or a related discipline, preferably with coursework in fluid mechanics, numerical methods and CFD.
Previous experience with a CFD solver and programming or data analysis is an advantage.
Language skills: Good command of English, both spoken and written, for technical discussions, documentation and presentations.
Availability: Able to undertake a five-month internship as part of your ongoing studies.

Additional Information
Start of assignment: By agreement.
Location: Solna. 
Application – a document with your CV.
Application deadline: 2026-11-30.
Contact person and proposed supervisor at Vattenfall: Eric Lillberg, Senior Principal R&D Engineer, Fluid Mechanics/CFD, eric.lillberg@vattenfall.com, +46 70 537 29 94.

Diversity and Inclusion – In Everything We Do
At Vattenfall, we value being Active, Positive, Open, and Safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our company culture. We believe that diversity helps build a more successful and attractive company, and we strive to be role models in diversity and inclusion. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have equal opportunities and rights, regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.
Vattenfall is part of Sweden’s critical infrastructure, and therefore many of our positions are security-classified. If this position is security-classified, a security screening will be conducted prior to employment in accordance with the Swedish Security Protection Act.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

We are looking to expand our EATS´ team with a Calibration Engineer to work within Engine Controls & Diagnostics.
Job description:
You will work in a team responsible for securing that the engine fulfils the emission legislation, by developing and calibrating its own inhouse software models. The team consists of calibration engineers and function developers. You & the team will calibrate start and catalyst heating, emission control and purge control. The team delivers engine software to combustion engines in both mild hybrid and hybrid applications. 
From an early stage you will be involved in the development of new powertrain concepts and its software, where the team has the responsibility for vehicle emissions, and develop solutions that meet both legal requirements and give the customer an outstanding product. 
Early in the projects you will  be collecting data from the engine test rigs, in order to calibrate the software-models. Validation and later, final verification are always performed in cars or what the application is suited for. The job variety is huge and the need for further development is always there, which provides an interesting research atmosphere.
What you will do:
You will work in a team with experienced engineers but have a clear area of responsibility. Your main tasks will be to calibrate emission-related functions. 
The team is doing a large amount of our work in different engine test cells located in the laboratory, but also in vehicles on site and during expeditions to find extreme climates and altitudes. You will use advanced programs for modelling and data processing for best results.
﻿Main tasks:
Plan and develop methods of the calibration process.
Define and handle requirements within the system and from other areas.
Deliver calibration and verification of emission related functions.
Verify calibration in rigs and cars in different environments.
Evaluation and problem analysis.

 
Is this you?
To enjoy and succeed in the role, we see that you have a great interest in the latest technology, and you have an interest in powertrain controls and calibration. You also like to dig into a huge amount of data. You are a positive and self-driven person, who strives to see "the big picture" to be able to contribute in the best way. You appreciate being a part of a team and are a good communicator. Further, you are always curious, and love to solve problems in a pragmatic way!
 Skill requirements
Qualifications:
•	We believe you have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in the field of Mechanical, Physics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent You have a passion for cars and internal combustion engines.
•	Fluent in Matlab/Python/Simulink
•	Fluent in English (written and spoken)
•	Driver’s license (Swedish B-level, passenger car)
•	Fluent in Swedish (written and spoken) is a plus
•	Good knowledge of internal combustion engines
•	Passion for vehicles and powertrains
•	Theoretical courses in combustion engines, software programming and electronics
•	Experience in ETAS INCA software
﻿Personal qualities
•	Self-driven with a positive attitude
•	Strong analytical skills as well as being able to execute tests “hands-on”
•	You plan, conduct, summarize and report your work in a structured and thorough manner
•	A curious and problemsolving mindset
• You can easily communicate and collaborate
• A true teamplayer open and supportive
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to advanced engine development while being part of a collaborative and supportive team.
You need to be living in Sweden and be able to work 100% onsite in Gothenburg.
Looking forward to meeting you!

jobs.occupation: Java Developer (AWS & Azure) - Consultant Assignment in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
About the assignment
We are currently looking for a Java Developer with Azure and AWS experience for an exciting consultant assignment at WirelessCar in Gothenburg. You will work closely with experienced engineers and other technical roles in an international environment.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building software, working with cloud technologies, and ensuring services run reliably in production. You will join a high-performing team responsible for developing, deploying, and operating cloud-based connected vehicle services for a global automotive customer.
As part of the team, you will work across the full lifecycle of the solution, from software development and deployment to monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The role combines backend development with cloud operations, automation, and production support, offering a great opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies in a collaborative and international environment.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and maintain backend services and supporting components in a cloud-native environment

Take an active role in operating production services, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance

Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and participate in incident investigation and resolution

Improve observability through logging, metrics, monitoring, and alerting

Automate operational tasks and continuously improve deployment and operational processes

Contribute to root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to avoid recurring incidents

Collaborate closely with developers, architects, QA engineers and other stakeholders to continuously improve the service
